note: Every kernel's mutation gate (witness v0.6, pinned) runs on GitHub's runner on every push (.github/workflows/light.yml), and light/tools/witness-check.mjs fails the build unless that run is clean AND re-derives exactly these counts. Each per-mutant test runs under an OS timeout and a 4 GiB address-space cap. The codec gate used to run only on this laptop: the hosted runner shut down ~90-150 s into it, and on 2026-11-05 the cause was measured, not guessed: the mutant that flips the journal-growth guard (log.jn === log.J.length to !==) took the runner from 1 GB to 15.8 GB of RAM in 20 s. Under the cap that mutant dies in its own test, and the full codec run passes on the runner with the same 96/100 the local run recorded. The reviewed-equivalent survivors, each with its written reason, are in light/witness.baseline.json.
